digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler — ticket planner shadow validation and manifest rendering
propositions: Shadow ticket planner mutations and dispositions must match legacy differ output except for explicitly named approved deltas across the ticket corpus
Preview output must add a versioned lifecycle_intents section additively while preserving mutation array bytes and serialize_manifest canonical hash unchanged
Construction, check, dry-run, and shadow execution paths must perform zero repository saves, ticket writes, Jira calls, or subprocess launches
Parity failure diagnostics must identify ticket identity, observation version, and differing plan fields without unbounded or sensitive content exposure
Golden test fixtures must validate normal, deferred dependency, filtered, tombstoned, and partial-snapshot plan scenarios with byte-stability and parity guarantees
